# Chill Numbers — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org

## About
Chill Numbers is a financial management and bookkeeping web application for individuals and small businesses.
It allows users to track income and expenses, manage bank accounts, generate financial reports, manage employees and payroll, and connect bank accounts via Plaid.

## Product
- Website: https://chillnumbers.com
- Pricing: https://chillnumbers.com/pricing
- Target audience: small business owners, freelancers, entrepreneurs, self-employed individuals

## Features
- Transaction management (income/expense with categories)
- Account management (assets, liabilities, equity)
- Employee management and payroll tracking
- Financial reports: profit & loss, category breakdown, weekly close, transaction summary
- Analytics dashboard with charts and KPIs
- Bank account sync via Plaid integration
- Subscription billing via Stripe
- Weekly financial reports by email
- AI financial assistant (Gemini-powered)
- Available in English and Spanish

## Pricing
- Free trial: 30 days, no credit card required
- Monthly plan: $9.99/month
- Annual plan: $99.99/year ($8.33/month)
